Tredict already pulls nightly HRV from Oura into the form curve, and your API has a health-data endpoint. I'd like to push Vybe's overnight data there for our DevKit testers. Could we do a quick call on credentials and data format?
opportunity: Become a Tredict health-data source via the public Tredict API health-data receiving endpoint (same slot Oura fills: nightly HRV, sleep, resting HR in the form curve).
unknowns: API terms/approval criteria and pricing not read; user count unknown; named partner contact not found (application form only).
